findings.description: verl BaseTool.__init__(self, config, tool_schema) requires TWO params. Our EDASandboxTool.__init__(self, config) only takes ONE.
findings.fix: Add tool_schema param and pass to super().__init__()

findings.description: verl create() returns str. Our tool returns Tuple. verl uses return as instance_id.
findings.fix: Change create() to return just instance_id (str)

findings.description: verl execute() returns Tuple[str, float, dict]. Our tool returns Tuple[Dict,...]. verl passes response string to add_tool_response_message(tokenizer, resp).
findings.fix: Serialize response dict to JSON string before returning

findings.description: verl calls calc_reward(instance_id) at episode end. Our 0.0 return is correct.
verl sets max_turns = max_model_len // 3 if None. With 16384 gives 5461 turns.
findings.fix: Set max_turns: 3 explicitly (done in config v2)

findings.description: Tool response pushing input_ids >= max_model_len forces STOP. False negatives possible.
findings.fix: Mitigate with ctx=16384+ (done). Monitor false_negative_rate in smoke.

findings.description: Malformed tool call args are SILENTLY DROPPED. Model thinks it called a tool.
findings.fix: Log decode_error_count. Penalize in R4 arm.

findings.description: Generation hitting response_length limit breaks rollout with already_over_long=True.
RL config v2 has tool_config_path: null. verl returns empty lists when None. NO tools loaded, multi-turn cannot work.
findings.fix: Create tool_config.yaml. Set tool_config_path when enabling multi_turn.

findings.description: verl loads tools from YAML via OmegaConf. Class loaded via importlib. Tool must be importable from verl venv Python path.
findings.fix: Ensure tool v2 on PYTHONPATH. Use full module path in class_name.

findings.description: Two mechanisms: (1) per-tool calc_reward() at episode end, (2) external compute_score via NaiveRewardManager. Our design uses (2), returns 0 from (1).
findings.fix: Document. Verify compute_score receives tool responses in smoke.

findings.description: tool_reward_scores in _req.reward_scores. May not propagate to training loop.
verl supports 'chatml' and 'qwen'. MiniCPM5-2B uses ChatML.
get_tool_call_parser_type(tokenizer) may return None for MiniCPM5-2B. If None, tool calls NOT detected. POTENTIAL BLOCKER.
findings.fix: Check parser type in smoke. If None, register custom parser.

findings.description: Multi-turn processes each prompt individually. Tool calls run via asyncio.gather.
findings.fix: Ensure execute() is async. Use asyncio.to_thread() for CPU-bound Tier3.

findings.description: SandboxFusionTool uses Ray TokenBucketWorker. Our tool has no rate limiting.
findings.fix: Add if needed. Not needed for Tier3.
